thread:
harry: Quick sync 1: we have two outbound deals pushing for a private on-prem license model. They want: flat license fee + per-token overage, and an optional observability retention add-on. Need packaging and minimums.
yvonne: Summary from sales: Customer A wants a single-seat license (per-cluster), Customer B wants usage-based billing tied to throughput. Both want 12 month terms.
li: Engineering note: on-prem metering is messy. We can provide an agent that reports usage, but it requires attestation and audit logs. Also needs offline billing fallback.
nora: Legal flagged export/control issues for on-prem. For regulated customers we need an indemnity clause and support SLA. Contracts will push for higher base fee to offset support burden.
contracts-bot: Draft constraint: "On-prem license requires an ingress/egress audit clause, and a minimum support retainer equal to 15% of annual license fee." Will attach template later.
harry: Pricing options on the table: A) High base license + low per-token overage B) Low base + higher per-token C) Pure commit (prepaid tokens) with conversion rules. Thoughts?
yvonne: Sales preference: C (prepaid commit) for predictability. They prefer credits that the customer can burn on their appliance.
li: Tech preference: A simplifies ops — treating on-prem as enterprise sale with support buffer. B and C both doable but increase billing integration work.
ora: From legal: require minimum annual MRR floor for on-prem customers to qualify for priority support. Suggest floor = $50k/year.
finance-bot: Financial model: with floor 50k/yr, expected ARR per deal >$60k, margin assumptions ok. If pure prepaid credits, we need revenue recognition rules (deferred rev) and refund policy.
harry: Observability retention add-on: customers want longer retention for logs/traces (12-24 months). This could be an a la carte add-on or tied to premium support.
yvonne: Sales wants it a la carte. Ops says long retention on-prem increases storage and maintenance burden.
ops-bot: Ops proposal: offer retention tiers: 90 days (default), 12 months (add-on), 24 months (premium). Add-on priced by GB/mo per cluster. Also require a minimum data retention cap to avoid tiny purchases.
li: Implementation notes for metering and add-on:

```
# on-prem reporting sketch
agent -> signed-usage-report (daily)
fields: tenant_id, cluster_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, timestamp, sig
fallback: local-aggregation-file uploaded monthly
```

nora: Contract language proposal: include a clause that the customer maintains a tamper-evident reporting agent; Redwood reserves audit rights and may perform on-site verification for material discrepancies.
harry: Launch gating suggestion: - legal template approved - billing export and rev rec path validated - at least one pilot customer signed for on-prem + retention addon - sample contract with floor and indemnity
yvonne: Sales ask: allow negotiated exceptions for strategic customers; require sales exec signoff for below-floor deals.
li: Dev tasks: build signed-usage-report + offline aggregator (ETA 3w), implement retention storage quotas and billing keys (ETA 2w).
finance-bot: Create SKU IDs: ONPREM-LIC-1Y, ONPREM-TOK-OVER, OBS-RET-12M, OBS-RET-24M. Add accountant tags for deferred revenue handling.
contracts-bot: I'll attach a first-pass amendment template and the indemnity wording. Also flag export-control review required for APAC deals.
harry: Decision (tentative): default packaging = Option A (higher base license + low overage) with optional prepaid credits path for select customers. Observability sold as add-on tiers. Minimum annual floor $50k, exceptions by sales exec. Pilot path: convert Customer A to pilot within 2 weeks.
yvonne: I'll prep sales one-pager with pricing matrix and exceptions flow. Also will coordinate pilot signatures.
li: I'll start the agent spec and share the schema by EOW.
harry: Thanks all. I'll post this summary to product docs and create the pilot tracker. :white_check_mark:
